secondary_constraints: Do not materially regress vs_Medium relative to best known checkpoint unless justified by a stronger path to vs_Deep >= 50%.
Do not materially regress vs_Random relative to best known checkpoint unless justified by a stronger path to vs_Deep >= 50%.

evaluation_protocol.description: Use a fixed deterministic eval suite to reduce leaderboard noise.
notes: Use no root Dirichlet noise during evaluation.
Evaluate both sides for each opening state.
Track vs_Random, vs_Deep, and vs_Medium for regressions.

research_space: Search hyperparameters: mcts_sims, cpuct, temperature schedules, dirichlet_alpha.
Training pipeline: optimizer/lr schedules, replay buffer strategies, duplicate-handling strategies.
Modeling: CNN and MiniBT4 size/regularization adjustments with matched parameter budgets.
Data quality: position diversity, canonical dedup ratios, and weighting effects.
Implementation changes: add/modify code paths when sweeps alone are unlikely to reach the target.
